dependencies.name: openspec-cli
dependencies.purpose: OpenSpec proposal, spec, task, validation, and archive workflows.
dependencies.failureMode: Missing, drifted, or failing OpenSpec blocks spec-driven DevFlow tasks.
dependencies.fallbackOrBlocker: Install the expected package or run the recorded updater in explicit apply mode.

dependencies.name: gsd-core
dependencies.purpose: Project-local GSD runtime used by DevFlow planning, verification, and state commands.
dependencies.failureMode: Missing, drifted, or failing GSD Core blocks project-local planning and verification automation.
dependencies.fallbackOrBlocker: Run the recorded project-local installer in explicit apply mode for the target repo.

dependencies.name: superpowers
dependencies.purpose: Methodology gates for brainstorming, planning, TDD, review, verification, and subagent execution discipline.
dependencies.failureMode: Missing or outdated Superpowers weakens DevFlow planning, TDD, review, verification, and subagent execution discipline.
dependencies.fallbackOrBlocker: Install or upgrade Superpowers explicitly, then review and trust bundled hooks with /hooks.

dependencies.name: plugin-eval
dependencies.purpose: Release quality gate for plugin packaging and marketplace readiness.
dependencies.failureMode: Missing Plugin Eval prevents release-quality scoring unless a blocker is recorded.
dependencies.fallbackOrBlocker: Use the installed Plugin Eval plugin script or record why Plugin Eval is unavailable.
